title: Disposal of electrolyte; prohibited.
bodyText: No person shall dispose of electrolyte from any used lead acid battery onto the ground or into sewers, drainage systems, surface or ground waters, or ocean waters.
bodyHtml: [§342I-1.5]  Disposal of electrolyte; prohibited.  No person shall dispose of electrolyte from any used lead acid battery onto the ground or into sewers, drainage systems, surface or ground waters, or ocean waters. [L 1991, c 201, pt of §1]
